QuestInfo.name: Hot-Air Balloon Motor
QuestInfo.0: You found one of Spiegelmann's lost tools while you were looking for artifacts.
QuestInfo.2: Spiegelmann just about kissed you when you brought back the motor for his hot-air balloon. Really... it got pretty awkward.
QuestInfo.1: Bring this back to Spiegelmann. He'll probably be excited!

0.0: What do I do... what do I do... what do I do... \n#b(Spiegelmann is in quite a tizzy.)#k

no.0: Hey, #b#h0##k. I didn't peg you for the kind of person that'd just leave a person in need...

1.0: I just can't be a real-live artifact hunter if I can't see it all... The whole field of vision. The BIG PICTURE... You know what I'm saying?!
1.1: I know you don't, but you DO have the adventurer's spirit. That's why you found it for me! How about you and me going on a hot air-balloon ride? We can share our sweat and passion... about ARTIFACTS! No? Not buying that one?
